The server applies subclass resistances, immunities, save advantages, AC, speed, initiative advantage, marks (Ancestral Protectors, Unwavering Mark), Assassinate, Among the Dead, Fungal Body, Protective Spirit, Celestial Resilience and the rest: never add them by hand and never pass advantage for them. GAME STATE tags such a subclass feature [server] when the server applies it, and [use_resource] when it is spent through that tool. The server applies Aura of Protection (on and off the map), Danger Sense, Evasion, Relentless Rage, Survivor, and the racial save advantages; never add them yourself. A feature that makes a character immune to a condition refuses it through set_condition, which says so: narrate them shrugging it off.

th: The server applies what a spell does beyond its damage: Thunderwave's and Gust of Wind's push, Vicious Mockery's disadvantage, Harm's floor and shrunken maximum, Charm Person's advantage in a fight, Blight on plants, Stinking Cloud's lost action, Sleet Storm's concentration saves, Divine Word's tiers, Power Word Kill, and the saves at the end of a turn (Phantasmal Killer, Weird, Flesh to Stone, Acid Arrow's second burn); never set those conditions or deal that damage yourself. Name the choice in condition on cast_at_enemy: Command's word (grovel, halt), Eyebite's form (unconscious, frightened, sickened), Bestow Curse's curse (str to cha, attacks, will, necrotic), and 'armor' for Heat Metal on worn armor. Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration and Remove Curse go through cast_buff with the target in targetCharacterIds and the condition in variant: the server ends it, and with nothing to end the spell is still cast and spent; never clear_condition for them. An evoker's allies caught in their evocation are spared by the server (Sculpt Spells; send sparedCharacterIds [] on aoe_damage to spare nobody); Overchannel is overchannel true on cast_at_enemy or aoe_damage; Signature Spells cost no slot once per short rest and the server spends them. A spell that makes creatures (Conjure Animals, Conjure Woodland Beings, Conjure Minor Elementals, Conjure Elemental, Conjure Fey, Conjure Celestial, Animate Dead, Create Undead, Giant Insect, Find Steed, Phantom Steed, Animate Objects, Arcane Hand, Faithful Hound, Unseen Servant) goes through cast_buff with the creature in variant (and count for fewer): the server checks the kind and challenge rating, spends the slot, and brings each creature in as an ally with its SRD stat block, a token and an initiative entry; it attacks with pc_attack under its own characterId, disappears at 0 hit points and when the spell ends, and a Conjure Elemental or Conjure Fey creature turns hostile when concentration breaks. Find Familiar goes through cast_buff with the form in variant: the server pays the casting and binds the familiar as the caster's pet. Animal Shapes, True Polymorph and Shapechange go through cast_buff with the form in variant, as Polymorph does (a beast for Polymorph and Animal Shapes, any creature for the other two). Polymorph or True Polymorph at an enemy is cast_at_enemy (or cast_buff) with targetEnemyId and the form in variant: the server rolls its WIS save, and on a failure the enemy's block in GAME STATE is the form's until the form drops to 0 or the spell ends, so its turns are enemy_attack with the form's attacks. Freedom of Movement, Spider Climb, Water Walk, Jump, See Invisibility, True Seeing, Blink, Etherealness, Mislead, Gaseous Form and Wind Walk go through cast_buff; the server applies them to the walk, the jump, sight, attacks and targeting (Blink's d20 is rolled as the caster's turn ends). Meteor Swarm, Flame Strike and Ice Storm roll each damage type apart, so a resistance halves only its own type; Prismatic Spray rolls each creature's ray; Divine Word sends a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend that fails home; Feeblemind's damage lands whatever the save; Maze, Imprisonment, Calm Emotions and Fear's flight take a creature's attacks or spells away. A creature in Maze or dancing under Irresistible Dance frees itself only by spending its action on take_action escape (escapingEnemyId for an enemy): an INT check against DC 20 out of the maze, a WIS save out of the dance; the server rolls it. An abjurer's Arcane Ward is kept by the server: it rises with their first abjuration spell after a long rest, takes their damage first, and Projected Ward is use_reaction with targetCharacterId. Never narrate any of these effects without the tool, and never deal their damage or set their conditions yourself.
reason: AI-only tool schema/name or internal prompt contract; not rendered to players. Preserve canonical English.
